🧩 Add-ons

🧊 Modeling

  • All-in-One Toolkits & Interactive Creation:
    • MACHIN3tools 💰 : Continuously evolving collection of Blender tools and pie menus in a single customizable package.
    • KeKit : Extensive production toolkit adding CAD-like snapping, selection, modeling, and pie menu utilities to Blender.
    • Maxivz’s Interactive Tools : Context-sensitive modeling toolkit including smart selection, transformation, and Drop It surface alignment.
    • PolyQuilt : Fast Edit Mode modeling and retopology tool using left-mouse gestures for creating faces, knife cuts, edge loops, and fans without menus or shortcuts. [more info]
    • fSpy-Blender : Official importer bringing fSpy camera-matching projects into Blender for modeling from reference images.
  • Edit Mode, Curves & Modifiers:
    • LoopTools : Essential Edit Mode mesh utilities including bridge, loft, circle, flatten, relax, and space tools.
    • F2 : Extends single-vertex and edge face creation in Edit Mode for faster quad retopology and modeling.
    • tinyCAD Mesh tools : CAD-style edge intersection, bisector, XALL, and circle-from-points utilities for Edit Mode.
    • Auto Mirror : Automates mesh bisection and Mirror modifier setup with clipping enabled. [thread]
    • Mesh Align Plus : Precisely align, move, and measure+match objects and mesh parts in 3D scenes.
    • BezierUtility : Precision toolkit for editing, splitting, offsetting, and measuring Bezier curves in Blender.
    • Tissue : Computational design and tessellation toolkit for generating procedural mesh patterns.
    • BY-GEN : Simplifies creating non-destructive, procedural, and generative modeling styles with modifiers in Blender.
    • Modeling Cloth : Real-time cloth-like mesh deformation directly inside Blender.
    • JewelCraft : Jewelry design toolkit with gem placement, weights, and measurement tools.
  • CAD:
    • Bonsai (formerly BlenderBIM) : Native OpenBIM authoring and IFC management suite for creating architectural and structural data in Blender. [website]
    • Archipack 💰 : Parametric ArchViz primitives and real-time on-screen editing tools for walls, roofs, stairs, and windows.
    • Building Tools : Procedural building and facade generation add-on for Blender.
    • Sverchok : Node-based parametric visual programming system for computational architecture and geometry.
    • CAD Sketcher : Constraint-based 2D CAD sketching and precision modeling toolkit inside Blender. [website]
    • CAD Transform : Precise CAD-style move, rotate, and scale snapping with constraints in Object and Edit modes.
    • MeasureIt-ARCH : Architectural drafting, dimensioning, and vector CAD drawing extension built on MeasureIt.
  • 3D Printing & Manufacturing/CAM:
    • 3D Print Toolbox : Utilities to check, clean, and export manifold models for 3D printing in Blender.
    • Snapsplit : Automates splitting oversized 3D prints with glue-free precision snap-fit connectors.
    • Click Joints : Cuts printable ball-and-socket or pin joints with millimeter clearance and collision-angle previews.
    • BlenderCAM : Open-source CNC and CAM toolpath generation inside Blender.
  • Retopology & Sculpt:
    • RetopoFlow : Interactive viewport retopology suite with contour, stroke, and poly-strip drawing tools for Blender.
    • QRemeshify : Easy-to-use auto-remesher outputting clean quad topology.
    • GoB : GoZ-compatible bridge for seamless ZBrush and Blender sculpting interchange.
  • Hard Surface:
    • Bool Tool : Streamlines non-destructive and destructive Boolean workflows with viewport shortcuts.
    • KIT OPS : Fast kitbashing and Boolean insert system for industrial and hard-surface scenes.
    • ND : Free non-destructive and interactive hard-surface toolkit with smart modifiers and Booleans.
    • HardOps/Boxcutter 💰 : Industry-standard hard-surface modeling assistant (HardOps) and interactive Boolean cutting suite (Boxcutter).
    • EdgeFlow : Adjusts edge loop curvature and spacing to align cleanly with surrounding mesh topology.

🦑 Generator/Builder

  • Characters & Faces:
    • CharMorph : Open-source character creation tool for Blender, built as a modern rewrite of MB-Lab.
    • MPFB : Open-source human generator for Blender and complete rewrite of MakeHuman as a native add-on. [docs]
    • FaceBuilder 💰 : Creates photorealistic 3D models of human faces and heads from a few reference photographs. [medium]
  • Environment, Terrain & Vegetation:
    • Infinigen : Procedural generator of photorealistic 3D worlds, nature, and indoor scenes using real geometry, optimized for computer vision and 3D training data.
    • The Grove 3D 💰 : Simulates natural tree growth, branching, pruning, and seasonal changes for visualization and film.
    • Modular Tree : Node-based procedural tree and vegetation generator for Blender.
    • Sapling Tree Gen : Parametric Weber-Penn trees with leaves, pruning, armature rigs, and wind animation.
    • IvyGen : Procedurally grows realistic ivy and climbing vegetation across mesh surfaces in Blender.
  • Architecture, Props & Data:
    • Archimesh : Generates parametric architectural elements including rooms, doors, windows, stairs, and roofs.
    • Buildify : Geometry Nodes library for modular procedural building creation.
    • SceneCity 💰 : Generates large-scale road networks and places tens of thousands of procedural and custom buildings.
    • BookGen : Free book-generation add-on for shelves and interior scenes in Blender.
    • Bricker 💰 : Converts 3D meshes and simulations into photorealistic Lego and Minecraft brick models.
    • Sprytile : Builds tile-based low-poly scenes in Blender with paint and map-editor tools. [more info]
    • Mesh Maze : Generates procedural maze patterns over any mesh surface.
    • Blender Data Visualisation : Loads data into Blender and generates 3D charts and visualizations.
  • Scatter:
    • Geo-Scatter 💰 : Professional biome and instancing scattering system for Blender.
    • BagaPie Modifier : Modifier and Geometry Nodes preset toolkit including booleans, scattering, arrays, and architecture tools.
  • Geometry Nodes Packs & Presets:
    • Higgsas Geometry Nodes : Extensive collection of utility and deformer node groups for Geometry Nodes, plus Mesh Tension Map.
    • b3dsdf : Over 170 signed distance functions (SDF), vector operations, and procedural utility node groups for Shader Editor and Geometry Nodes in Blender.

🗺️ Texture/UV

  • UV Unwrapping, Packing & Texel Density:
    • TexTools : TexTools is a Free addon for Blender 3D with a set of professional UV and Texturing tools.
    • Magic UV : This is a blender add-on Magic UV consisted of many UV manipulation features which Blender lack of. [docs]
    • DreamUV : Collection of tools that allow you to manipulate UVs in the 3D viewport.
    • UV-Packer : Automatic and free UV-Packer Add-on for Blender.
    • UVgami : Automatic UV unwrapping add-on for Blender with minimal distortion.
    • Texel Density Checker : Tools for calculate, set and copy texel density.
  • Texture Baking:
    • Bake Wrangler : Nodes based extension and replacement for the inbuilt baking system.
    • Bystedts Blender Baker : Streamlines high-to-low-poly texture baking setup, cage creation, and batch map exports in Blender.
  • Material Libraries, Layer Painting & Bridges:
    • UcuPaint : Layer-based texture painting and procedural channel manager for EEVEE and Cycles.
    • Grungit : Adds controllable procedural edge wear, dirt, and surface damage to models with one click.
    • Sanctus Library 💰 : Ever-growing procedural material library for Blender.
    • Poliigon Blender Addon : Browse, download, and import Poliigon textures, models, and HDRIs inside Blender with Asset Browser support.
    • Lily Surface Scraper : Imports PBR shaders and textures directly into Blender from a single website URL.

🎬 Lighting, Camera & Video

  • Lighting & Environment:
    • Gaffer : Light manager that presents all scene lighting and HDRI settings in streamlined panels for quick experimentation.
    • Extra Lights : Adds physically based, photometric lighting presets to the Add menu.
    • HDRI Sun Aligner : Automatically rotates a sun lamp or object to match the brightest point in an HDRI environment texture.
    • LeoMoon LightStudio : Interactive studio lighting system for Blender.
    • Physical Starlight and Atmosphere 💰 : Full procedural sky, sunlight, and atmosphere simulator for visual consistency across scenes.
    • Sun Position : Positions the sun lamp and Sky texture accurately by geographic coordinates, date, and time.
    • Projectors : Creates physically plausible optical projectors with gobo textures in Cycles and EEVEE.
  • Camera & Batch Rendering:
    • Photographer 2 : Physical camera exposure, white balance, and autofocus controls (v2 available for free).
    • Camera Shakify : Adds realistic, motion-captured camera shake to Blender cameras.
    • Loom : Simplifies rendering specific frame ranges, batch rendering, and background video encoding.
  • Video Sequence Editor (VSE) & Audio:
    • Power Sequencer : Free and open-source productivity tools for faster editing in Blender's Video Sequence Editor.
    • VSEQF : Quick Functions overhaul for Blender VSE focused on real-time feedback and mouse/keyboard editing.
    • Push to Talk : Record scratch dialogue directly into the VSE timeline.
    • LUT Exporter : Exports .cube LUT files from VSE adjustment layers.

↑ Back to top

🗜 Render Engine

  • Pixar's RenderMan : Physically-based production renderer from Pixar with an open-source Blender bridge (free non-commercial tier; proprietary renderer license applies). [docs]
  • OctaneRender Prime for Blender : Fully integrated Octane Render, free tier. (blender plugin manual)
  • Redshift Blender Integration 💰 : Redshift by Maxon is a GPU-accelerated renderer built to meet the specific demands of contemporary high-end production rendering.
  • LuxCore : LuxCoreRender is a physically based and unbiased rendering engine. It offers advanced features like accelerated rendering of indirect light and efficient rendering of caustics. (blender addon)
  • Malt : Malt is a non photorealistic rendering (NPR) framework. It offers fully customizable real-time rendering framework for animation and illustration.
  • Mitsuba Renderer : Mitsuba 3 is a research-oriented retargetable rendering system for forward and inverse light transport simulation. (blender addon)
  • K-Cycles 💰 : Optimized custom Cycles build of Blender featuring faster GPU rendering, post-processing effects, and performance presets.

↑ Back to top

🌠 Animation

  • Animation & Motion:
    • Commotion : Motion-graphics toolset for offset animations and multi-object timing in Blender.
    • Animax 💰 : Procedural animation system for animating large object arrays and effects.
    • COA Tools : 2D cutout animation suite offering a Spine/Spriter-style rigged sprite workflow inside Blender.
    • Stop-Mo : Transforms animations into a hand-crafted stop-motion look with stepped timing controls.
    • Blender NLA Midi Copier : Creates MIDI-driven animations directly inside Blender's Nonlinear Animation (NLA) editor.
  • Rigging:
    • CloudRig : Blender Studio's official feature-film quality Rigify feature set and rig generator for Blender.
    • BlenRig : Auto-rigging and skinning system delivering feature-film character rigs, including an advanced facial system.
    • Rig on the Fly : Rig on the Fly is a Blender dynamic rigging tool used to simplify and speed up animation workflow.
    • Auto-Rig Pro 💰 : Auto-Rig Pro is an addon for Blender to rig characters, retarget animations, and provide Fbx export, with presets for Unity and Unreal Engine.
    • Rigacar : Generate a complete rig as quickly as possible for standard car models.
    • Wiggle Bones : Jiggle bone implementation for Blender with realistic secondary physics.
    • Spring Bones : Blender addon to add spring/bouncy dynamic effect to bones.
    • Bone Widget : Blender addon to assist with making custom bone shapes.

↑ Back to top

🌊 Simulation/Physics

  • FLIP Fluids : Powerful liquid simulation plugin that gives you the ability to create high quality fluid effects all within Blender, the free and open source 3D creation suite.
  • MolecularNodes : Import, animate, and simulate molecular biology and structural data inside Blender using Geometry Nodes.
  • Molecular+ : Modernized continuation of the Molecular Script add-on for particle collisions, linking, and physics simulations in Blender 4.x.
  • Cell Fracture : Shatters meshes into Voronoi-based rigid-body fragments for destruction simulations in Blender.
  • Phobos : Robotics modeling add-on for creating URDF, SDF, and SMURF robot descriptions in Blender.
  • Blender Optics Simulator
